name: Missing-Pattern Conflict Graph
definition: For a binary class $C$, let $\mathcal R(C)$ be its full clutter of minimally missing signed patterns. The missing-pattern conflict graph has vertex set $\mathcal R(C)$ and joins two patterns when they prescribe opposite values at some common coordinate.
codomain: Finite simple graphs, considered up to signed-coordinate isomorphism
parameters: The full minimally missing-pattern clutter; binary clauses are retained.
normalization: Repeated descriptions of the same minimal signed pattern are identified. The empty family has the single empty missing pattern and no conflict edges.
comments: The graph records conflicts among all minimally missing patterns. Tests that retain only patterns of support at least three define different invariants.
